title: The matching scheme of a termwise fibre product is the fibre product of the matching schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $U_\bullet\to X$, $V_\bullet\to X$ be augmented simplicial $X$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]. Let $W_\bullet\to X$ be the augmented simplicial $X$-scheme with $W_n=U_n\times_XV_n$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] of the structure morphisms to $X$), whose face and degeneracy maps are the induced morphisms $d_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}d_i$, $s_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}s_i$ and whose augmentation is the structure morphism $W_0\to X$, and let $p:W_\bullet\to U_\bullet$, $q:W_\bullet\to V_\bullet$ be the termwise projections. For $n\geq0$ write $M_n(-)$ for the matching scheme of [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]: $M_0(-)=X$, and for $n\geq1$ the limit, in schemes over $X$, of the diagram formed by the terms in degrees $k<n$ indexed by the injective non-identity order-preserving maps $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ (with the simplicial operators between them), and write $\mu_n^U:U_n\to M_n(U)$ for the matching map whose $\delta$-component is the simplicial operator of $\delta$ (for $n=0$ the augmentation). Then for every $n\geq0$ the morphism $(M_n(p),M_n(q)):M_n(W)\to M_n(U)\times_XM_n(V)$ induced by $p$ and $q$ is an isomorphism, and under it $\mu_n^W$ corresponds to the induced morphism $\mu_n^U\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\mu_n^V:U_n\times_XV_n\to M_n(U)\times_XM_n(V)$.
